candidate.user_submission: This child is 18 months old and has fever. The fever has been there for 2 days. The temperature is 38.0°C. Malaria risk in the area is high. The malaria test is available and the result is positive. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no cough or difficult breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have ear problem. There is no generalized rash. There is no obvious cause of fever that I can see. No identified bacterial cause is present. The child did not have measles within the last 3 months and there is no measles cough. The child does not have red eyes, runny nose, or stiff neck.
